rule.myavalon.enable_bots.description: Unoccupied chairs are taken by AI players, so one person can start a game. Off means five real players are required.
rule.myavalon.seats.description: Fill the table to this many players. Real players come first and bots make up the difference (only while bots are enabled).
rule.myavalon.bot_strength.description: Easy: votes yes to almost anything and plays whatever quest card it holds. Normal: tracks who has sabotaged, keeps evil off its own teams, and evil sabotages when it is safe. Hard: also reasons about the Allay, and evil holds its sabotage back until the quest is at risk. Click to cycle.
rule.myavalon.cunning_assassin.descripti: When on, a bot creeper reads the earlier rounds and picks whoever looks most like the Allay, instead of stabbing at random.
strength.myavalon.easy.description: Votes yes to almost anything and plays whatever quest card it holds.
strength.myavalon.normal.description: Tracks who has sabotaged and keeps a second evil off a team that already has one; evil sabotages when it is safe.
strength.myavalon.hard.description: On top of Normal, reasons about the Allay, and evil saves its sabotage until the quest is really at risk.

rule.myavalon.roles.description: Opens a screen to tick which identities are in play. Grey ones are always in; anything unticked is replaced by a Villager.
rule.myavalon.designated_quests.descript: When on, the leader names the quest as well as the team, and the quest chosen sets the team size. A completed quest cannot be chosen again; quest 5 needs two successes first. On 7+ players, quest 4 still needs two fail cards.
roles.myavalon.title: Identity setup
roles.myavalon.hint: Grey identities are in every game; anything unticked is replaced by a Villager. Reset returns to the built-in set.
stats.myavalon.usage: Usage: /myavalon rate [player] ...; player names or @a right after rate show the answer only to those players, omit them to show it to yourself (required from the console). /myavalon rate total [count] for the overall ranking; /myavalon rate good|evil [count] for a faction ranking; /myavalon rate role <mob id> [count] for an identity ranking; /myavalon rate personal [player] for overall, evil, good and per-role win rates (player can be a UUID or a name; omit it for yourself). Mob ids: allay (Allay), librarian (Librarian), villager (Villager), creeper (Creeper), illusioner (Illusioner), ender_dragon (Ender Dragon), phantom (Phantom), zombie (Zombie). Games with any bot seat are not counted.

rule.myavalon.plot_cards.description: When on, the leader draws 1-3 plot cards at the start of every quest round and hands each to a different player; everybody sees who holds what. Five or six players use the seven-card base set, seven or more the full fifteen. A rejected team does not draw again.
rule.myavalon.lady_of_the_lake.descripti: When on, the Angel starts with the player on the first leader's right. Before the third, fourth and fifth quests its holder must examine one player (there is no skip): mark a player, then press the middle Confirm to begin; a loyalty card flies to the middle of the table. When it is done the token passes to the examined player and the next proposal waits for the card. Three uses per game, and a player who has used the Angel can never be examined.
rule.myavalon.excalibur.description: When on, the leader gives the sword while the team is being picked: click a member's avatar to hand it over, and the team cannot be confirmed until it has been given. After every quest card is down and before the reveal, the holder may name one member and flip that card (success becomes fail and vice versa), then see what it originally was. Using it is optional; a card played face up cannot be flipped.
rule.myavalon.lancelot.description: When on, one plain Villager becomes the Kind Wolf and one plain Minion becomes the Evil Wolf. After the second, third and fourth quests one loyalty card is turned over: three say no change, two say switch. On a switch both wolves move to the other side at once; quest-card restrictions, bot judgement and final win credit all follow the current side, while what Merlin was told at the deal never changes. A custom setup needs a Villager and a Minion for the swap to happen.
